verdict.rationale: ReelMimic turns a text instruction into a 2D video, but the documented flow always pairs that prompt with a reference video, file or YouTube link that it analyzes and mimics. Iteration without restarting is well covered: you can chat to refine the storyboard plan before approving, request changes in a side chat (screenshots accepted), and leave timestamped comments on the finished video. Missing for 10: evidence of pure text-only prompt-to-video without a reference clip, any independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and evidence beyond the 2D-only styles.
